name: Afterlife Harem
source:
After you die, a mysterious entity appears before you with a deal: Continue on your way and go to the afterlife, or be forgotten and live again.

If you decide to accept the deal, you will become a "Guide to the afterlife", and a new life will begin alongside others who also accepted the deal.

Basically 90% of the girls in the city are a love interest for you, not to mention your teammates. As you improve your relationship with your teammates they will be able to remember more about their past life, unlocking new events, new activities and more.

[From [url=https://aph-v.itch.io/afterlife-harem]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在你死后，一个神秘的实体出现在你面前，并提出了一项协议：继续你的道路并前往来世，或者被遗忘并再次生活。

如果你决定接受交易，你将成为“来世向导”，与同样接受交易的其他人一起开始新的生活。

基本上城里90%的女孩都是你的恋人，更不用说你的队友了。当你改善与队友的关系时，他们将能够记住更多关于他们过去的生活，解锁新事件、新活动等等。

[来自[url=https://aph-v.itch.io/afterlife-harem]itch.io[/url]]
